events.description: Called when the end of the list is reached and `hasMore` is true, never while `isLoading`.
events.name: onLoadMore

events.description: Called with the ids now selected each time the selection changes, in the order the items are in.
events.name: onSelectionChange

props.description: The spoken name of the list, for example "Recent orders".
props.name: label

props.description: The surface level the rows sit on. Defaults to `default`.
props.name: variant

props.description: True while a cursor page has a next one; `onLoadMore` is called only then.
props.name: hasMore

props.description:
The rows fade in and rise into place as one block when the list mounts, inside the list's surface (`Reveal`, ADR 0329). Defaults
to on; off, or under reduced motion, they show at once.
props.name: isAnimated

props.description: The items, in order. The collection never sorts or filters them: the query that fetched them did.
props.name: items

props.description: What the collection shows when `items` is empty and nothing is loading, usually an `EmptyState`.
props.name: emptyState

props.description: True while items load: the collection is busy, and shows its loading state in place of the empty one.
props.name: isLoading

props.description: The spoken name of what loads, for example "Loading orders"; it is read only while `isLoading` is true.
props.name: loadingLabel

props.description: What a press or Space does: nothing, select one item, or toggle several. Defaults to `none`.
props.name: selectionMode

props.description: The ids of the selected items, for a controlled collection; pair it with `onSelectionChange`.
props.name: selectedKeys

props.description: The ids selected at the start, for an uncontrolled collection.
props.name: defaultSelectedKeys

props.description: Additional CSS classes
props.name: className

props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
props.name: ref

events.description: Makes the row a button and is called when it is pressed; without it the row is plain content.
events.name: onPress

props.description: The row's main text, or any node when the row needs more than text.
props.name: title

props.description: The muted line under the title.
props.name: description

props.description: The leading visual: an icon by name, or an element drawn as given, usually an `Avatar`.
props.name: startIcon

props.description: What the row shows at its end, before the chevron: a `Chip`, a value, a switch.
props.name: endContent

props.description: Draws a chevron at the end that points the reading way, to say that the row opens something.
props.name: hasChevron

props.description: Refuses the press and the selection of a row that has either, and dims it; a plain row has nothing to refuse.
props.name: isDisabled

props.description: The accessible name when the title is not a string; also what type-ahead matches. Defaults to the title text.
props.name: label

props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
props.name: ref
